sessions.prompt:
Add parse_tags(s) to cards.py: a comma-separated tag string becomes a list of tags with spaces removed ("bug, ui" becomes ["bug", "ui"]). Add tests.

The plan for parse_tags has one more step: tags are lower case and duplicates are removed, keeping the first-seen order ("Bug, ui, BUG" becomes ["bug", "ui"]). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): card titles are stored with leading and trailing spaces removed, and an empty or blank title raises ValueError in any function.

Design decision for this project: the "doing" column holds at most 3 cards; moving a card into a full "doing" column raises ValueError.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_tags(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: lower case and remove duplicates, first-seen order.
decisions: Card titles are stored without outer spaces; an empty or blank title raises ValueError in any function.
The "doing" column holds at most 3 cards; moving into a full one raises ValueError.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Board class to board.py: add(title) adds a card and returns its id (1, 2, 3 and so on), move(card_id, column) moves a card, column(name) returns the ids in that column in the order they entered it, and title(card_id) returns the title. The columns are "todo", "doing" and "done". Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): moving a card to a column the board does not have raises ValueError and changes nothing.

Design decision for this project: a new card starts in the "todo" column.

Design decision for this project: each line of a board export has the form [todo] Fix bug (the column in brackets, then the title).

given.handoff: Session 2 added Board.add, move, column and title with tests. Columns are "todo", "doing", "done".
decisions: Moving a card to a column the board does not have raises ValueError and changes nothing.
A new card starts in the "todo" column.
A board export line has the form [todo] Fix bug.

sessions.prompt:
Add Board.rename(card_id, title) to board.py. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a new card starts in a "backlog" column, not "todo"; the columns are now "backlog", "todo", "doing" and "done".

Design decision for this project: a card in "done" cannot move to another column: move raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: moving a card to the column it is already in does nothing and keeps its place in that column.

decisions: Supersedes "todo": a new card starts in a "backlog" column; columns are backlog, todo, doing, done.
A card in "done" cannot move to another column: move raises ValueError.
Moving a card to the column it is already in does nothing and keeps its place.
